items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Leo Condilli, trumpet. Miff Moll, trombone; Dudley Fosdick, mellophone; Fud Livingston, clarinet; tenor; Art Miller, string bass. Chauncey Morehouse, drums, vibes, sometimes solo.
